plain_text:
CDC developed the Booster Seat Planning Guide to assist
States, Tribes, Localities, and Territories (STLTs) with
assessing, planning, and implementing improved booster seat
laws to reduce crash injuries and deaths among children.
semantic_text: CDC developed the Booster Seat Planning Guide to assist States, Tribes, Localities, and Territories (STLTs) with assessing, planning, and implementing improved booster seat laws to reduce crash injuries and deaths among children.

plain_text:
The guide begins with an overview of the public health problem of motor vehicle crashes involving children and how
crash injuries and deaths can be prevented. Next, the guide takes a step-by-step approach to help develop a tailored
plan to prevent crash injuries and deaths among children in your STLs. Finally, after working through the steps, you
will end with an action plan and communication strategy. The guide also includes a brief list of resources, training
aids, and links to technical assistance.
